metadata.target: Individual carbon species with the highest explicitly reported numeric Faradaic efficiency among at least two reported individual carbon species, with a unique positive maximum.
metadata.population: Organically modified copper catalysts; copper is constant, and catalyst features characterize modifier representations.
metadata.brier_definition: Mean over records of sum across classes of squared probability error; no division by class count; range 0 to 2.
metadata.calibration_cohort_note: Study-disjoint sigmoid calibration: 56 of 86 records from 14 DOI groups, compared only with raw predictions on the same records. Random-condition sigmoid calibration covers all 86 records.
metadata.full_cohort_metrics_note: metrics includes complete-cohort groups only; study-disjoint partial calibrated cohorts appear in calibration_matched_metrics.
metadata.bootstrap_note: 500 paired DOI-cluster bootstrap draws, percentile 95% intervals conditional on saved outer predictions, without refitting.
metadata.protocol_comparison_note: Random condition-grouped versus study-disjoint differences are descriptive because training information differs.

protocol.target_definition: Unique positive maximum among at least two explicitly numeric reported individual carbon-product FE values; missing FE is unreported, H2 and aggregate C2+/C3+ excluded.
protocol.duplicate_policy: DOI+exact modifier+polymer class+recorded conditions: exclude conflicting label groups, collapse consistent duplicate groups to first raw row.
protocol.model_selection: Fixed small CPU models; no parameter search; all preprocessing/calibration training-side only.
protocol.calibration: Training-only 3-fold source-group cross-fitting sigmoid when feasible; otherwise explicitly skip.
protocol.brier_definition: Mean over records of sum over four classes of squared probability minus one-hot target; range 0 to 2.

analysis_metadata.brier_definition: mean(sum_k((p_k-one_hot_k)^2)); no division by K; range [0,2]
analysis_metadata.equal_study_definition: one globally weighted confusion matrix, row weight 1/n_records_in_source
analysis_metadata.uncertainty: Source cluster percentile bootstrap conditional on saved OOF predictions; no refitting; fold variability is not confidence interval
analysis_metadata.protocol_comparison: descriptive; different training information, no causal/significance claim

reproduction_check.scope: Full clean-output rerun of split preparation, all fixed models, grouped sigmoid calibration and analysis (500 source-cluster bootstrap replicates).
reproduction_check.run_log_note: Wall time and machine runtime details are not expected to be byte-identical. No hyperparameters or split decisions changed.

package_reproduction_check.note: Requires original frozen config/engine/assignments. Run logs may differ in elapsed time.
